blurb: A small-cap and special-situations investment account on X, focused on identifying asymmetric opportunities in overlooked companies at the intersection of technology cycles — particularly optics, semiconductor equipment, AI infrastructure, and adjacent industrial themes. The account posts terse, riddle-style teasers designed to surface under-followed names before they receive institutional coverage, rewarding followers who have done the supply-chain and valuation work independently. Posting style is minimal-text, maximum-implication: a handful of bullet points rather than full write-ups.
credibility_note: No verifiable institutional affiliation or public track record available. The account's credibility rests on the quality of its thematic calls, which center on identifying companies with multiple secular tailwinds trading at distressed or ignored multiples. Identity and any managed positions are not publicly disclosed.
